999497481.description:
FlightReady E6B is a modern flight computer with the most complete set of aviation functions, conversions, and utilities for planning and flying.

WHY PILOTS USE FLIGHTREADY E6B
• Accurate. Conversions use exact defined factors, and airspeed and altitude calculations use the full U.S. Standard Atmosphere, maintaining accurate calculations above 36,000 feet.
• Explained. Every function and conversion has built-in help that describes what it calculates, how to use it, and the formulas and conventions behind it.
• Fast. Star the functions you use most to keep them at the top of the main menu, and your favorites sync to your other devices through iCloud. Open functions from Search, Shortcuts, Control Center, the Lock Screen, or the Action button.
• Easy to use. Change a field's unit from the menu beside it, and every related field on the screen follows. Results automatically carry over to related functions, reducing repeated data entry.
• Night-flight friendly. Dark mode uses a red-shifted amber color scheme designed for use in a dark cockpit.

PLAN LEG
▸ Heading & Groundspeed: true heading, groundspeed, and magnetic and compass heading
▸ Time & Distance: leg time, distance, or groundspeed
▸ Required True Airspeed: the true airspeed and heading needed to make a planned groundspeed
▸ Fuel Consumption: fuel required, fuel flow, or endurance
▸ Point of No Return and Equal Time Point, with ETAs

AIRSPEED, ALTITUDE, AND WEATHER
▸ Airspeed: actual TAS and Mach, plan Mach, plan TAS, and total air temperature
▸ Altitude: pressure, density, and true altitude
▸ Cloud Base: cloud base AGL and MSL, and relative humidity, from temperature and dew point

WIND
▸ Wind Component: headwind and crosswind
▸ Unknown Wind
▸ Wind Correction Angle

CLIMB & DESCENT
▸ Climb/Descent Rate: required gradient in ft/nm, percent, and degrees, and rate in ft/min
▸ Top of Descent: determine when to begin descent
▸ Gradient Conversion: percent, degrees, and ft/nm

PERFORMANCE
▸ Rate of Turn and Turn Radius for any bank angle and airspeed
▸ Standard Rate Bank Angle and Standard Rate Turn Radius
▸ Hydroplane Speed for rotating and non-rotating tires
▸ Load Factor in Level Turn
▸ Pivotal Altitude, AGL and MSL

NAVIGATION
▸ DME Arc Distance
▸ Lead Turn Distance: how far before a fix to start the turn
▸ Thunderstorm Cell Height from radar tilt and distance
▸ Time/Distance to Station from a VOR or NDB bearing change
▸ Holding Pattern: determine entry type and visualize the holding pattern

AERODYNAMICS
▸ Lift
▸ Power & Torque

WEIGHT & BALANCE
▸ C.G. & Moment: enter any two of weight, CG, and moment to get the third
▸ C.G. Shift: enter any three values to get the fourth, such as how much weight to move
▸ CG % of MAC

CONVERSIONS
▸ Temperature: °C, °F, K, and °R
▸ Distance: nautical miles, statute miles, kilometers, feet, and more
▸ Speed: knots, mph, km/h, ft/min, m/s, and Mach
▸ Pressure: inHg, mbar/hPa, kPa, psi, mmHg, and more
▸ Fuel @ 15°C: gallons, liters, pounds, and kilograms of 100LL, Jet-A, Jet-B, JP-8, and water
▸ Weight & Mass, Area, Liquid Volume (US and imperial), Volume, Density, Power, and Torque

TIME UTILITIES
▸ Time Calculator: add, subtract, multiply, and divide times, in decimal or formatted time, including h:m
▸ Flight Log Calculator: block and flight times from your out, off, on, and in times
▸ Standard Calculator
▸ IFR Timer: a countdown that keeps running when you lock your phone, with a notification when time is up

SETTINGS
▸ Results to as many as four decimal places
▸ Day, Night, and Auto appearance

1206876323.releaseNotes:
Alien Tribe 3 — What's New

Colonies & Supply

* Maintenance Station: Its drones rebuild destroyed structures right where they stood. The building costs still apply, though.
* Automatic mining by harvesters now only works near your Mining Depots, and idle harvesters park in your solar system.
* Storage limit: Metal and Isotope can only be stockpiled up to a limit. Every solar system you colonize raises it for good. When a stock is full, its counter pulses and harvesters wait with their cargo until there is room again.

Exploration

* You can only look into a newly discovered solar system once one of your ships has been there.
* Once every known planet is settled, your scientist tracks down the next unknown solar system for you after a while.

Research

* Ten new techs make your ships faster, your turrets sharper and your defenses tougher. Once everything is done, endless research keeps boosting weapons, shields and hull level by level

Combat & Defense

* The Maloc waves have changed their strategy and now strike in more varied places.
* Kytra being absorbed by your Containment are no longer attacked.
* The Maloc grow with your empire: the more solar systems you colonize, the stronger the waves. Large fleets arrive through several portals.
* Later waves no longer retreat after a fixed amount of damage. They fight until you drive them off.
* The Maloc only attack Kytra when the Kytra attack them first.

Interface & Quality

* Weapon stats: A unit's detail panel (long press) now shows details about your weapons.
* Destroying your own structure now asks for confirmation first, so a slip of the finger costs you nothing.
* Population growth: a thin line under the population bar shows how close the next colonist is.
* The colony view shows every production branch, and the System Overview adds each colony's production and food stock.
* Metal and Isotope are now shown exactly in the top left (1451 instead of 1.4K).
* Story dialogs now sit above notifications, and notifications wait until you close the dialog.

Fixes

* Research upgrades now fully apply to units you already own, including turrets and harvesters.
* Objects no longer pop up in the wrong map when switching views, and dismantling a Food Synthesizer refunds the right amount again
* Maloc waves now only appear near your colonized systems. After destroying an outpost they move on to the next colony instead of circling in space.
* Hint panels no longer reach past the top of the screen on small iPhones or with Display Zoom.

We're continuing to improve balance, UI clarity, and core systems based on player feedback.
1206876323.description:
The sequel to the real-time strategy classic Alien Tribe 2, which reached the Top 10 in more than 25 countries.

Explore a distant galaxy. Colonize new worlds. Research ancient technologies. Connect entire star systems into a unique energy network.

It all started with one unforgettable night: After escaping Maloc territory, the Fifo threw the biggest party in their history aboard their ark ship – and, for obvious reasons, didn't invite the autopilot. Big mistake.

The autopilot, a hopelessly outdated shipboard AI that had served the Fifo faithfully for centuries, finally had enough. Before sunrise, it beamed the entire tribe onto an unknown planet in a distant galaxy. The Fifo woke up with no ship, no way home – and one legendary hangover.

And things only got worse: The ruthless Maloc have picked up their trail again – presumably tipped off by the autopilot out of revenge. And the new galaxy is home to the Kytar: cute to look at, but anything but harmless.

The autopilot has given the Fifo a nearly impossible task: Colonize every star system and connect them all into one energy network – then it will return. Provided they promise to invite it to the next party.

Now it's up to you.

EXPLORE A DISTANT GALAXY

Send research ships into unknown star systems. Discover anomalies, investigate ancient wrecks, and uncover resource-rich asteroids. Every game takes place across newly generated star systems – no two are alike.

BUILD YOUR ENERGY NETWORK

Your energy network is at the heart of Alien Tribe 3. Connect solar power plants, planets, and defensive installations into a galactic power grid – the backbone of your entire infrastructure. If a connection breaks, everything downstream loses power. Plan carefully and defend every link.

EXPAND YOUR EMPIRE

Colonize planets, build mining stations, research centers, repair stations, and defensive installations. Secure resources and create an economy that can keep running even under constant pressure.

RESEARCH AND ADAPT

Expand your capabilities with a dynamic, card-based research system featuring around 25 technologies. Every decision comes at a cost: Will you focus on military strength, science, or your economy? Every game plays out differently.

COMMAND YOUR FLEET

Command harvesters, construction ships, research vessels, colony ships, and combat ships in real time. Each ship class has its own role.

FACE THE MALOC

Maloc attack waves strike from different directions and grow stronger over time. Build defense platforms, secure chokepoints, and decide when expansion matters more than defense.

PREMIUM, OFFLINE, FAIR

Buy once. Play forever. No ads. No in-app purchases. No pay-to-win. Fully playable offline – on a plane, on a train, or from your couch.

FEATURES

• Real-time strategy with 4X elements: exploration, expansion, research, and combat
• A galactic energy network at the heart of every strategic decision
• Card-based research system with around 25 technologies
• Procedurally generated star systems – every game is different
• More than 15 buildable stations and ships for economy, research, and defense
• Specialized ship classes with distinct roles
• Premium game: fully offline, no ads, no in-app purchases
• Optimized for iPhone and iPad

The galaxy is waiting. Build your energy network. Save the Fifo tribe.

1660790905.description:
We took all of the knowledge and feedback from our popular Long Division Calculator web application to create the best iOS Long Division Calculator App possible.

Our Long Division Calculator App allows larger numbers and has a lot more options than your standard division calculator app.

Long division is a process of solving a division problem in a series of steps. This app will show you each of these steps in detail for every problem you want solved.

Many division problems result in an answer with a remainder. For this reason, the app also includes a "Remainder to Decimal Converter" and a "Remainder to Fraction Converter."

As you can see, this app has everything you need in order to tackle any and all division problems using the long division method.

The app is fast, intuitive, and easy to use. It is a standalone app, which means that it will work perfectly fine in places with little or no Internet access.

We hope that the Long Division Calculator App will become one of your favorite math apps.

6801130306.description:
I'm a preventive cardiologist. I keep meeting people who only learn their blood pressure is high after it has already affected their heart, kidneys, brain or eyes. Home readings could have flagged it much sooner, if they're taken the right way.

So BP Log walks you through the method the latest guidelines recommend: two readings about a minute apart, averaged, because blood pressure shifts from minute to minute and a single number can mislead. It also shows your time in target next to your average, because an average can look fine while half your readings sit above goal.

Dr. Kaustubh Dabhadkar, U.S. board-certified cardiologist

GUIDED READINGS, DONE RIGHT
• Take two readings a minute apart. The app times it, chimes when your rest is up, and averages them for you
• Need more than two? Add extra readings and choose which ones to average, with every raw reading still saved
• Every reading classified against the current blood pressure categories the moment you log it

NEVER LOSE A READING
• Forgot to log one? Add a past reading from History with the date and time you took it
• Choose whether a reading counts as morning or evening, so your AM and PM averages stay accurate
• Edit any saved reading, with Undo if you delete one by mistake

ON YOUR WRIST
• Take a guided reading on Apple Watch: enter reading 1, rest a minute (your watch taps you when it's time), enter reading 2, and the average saves to your iPhone
• Add the Log BP complication to your watch face

STAYS IN SYNC
• Import your existing Apple Health history, then keep syncing automatically
• Log from Control Center, the Lock Screen, or Siri: "Hey Siri, log my blood pressure"
• Synced privately through your own iCloud account, never our servers

BUILT FOR YOUR NEXT VISIT
• A clean report of your trends, with every morning and evening reading in a detailed log, ready to hand to your doctor
• Prefer to share less? A "Summary only" report shows averages and charts without the day-by-day readings
• Full raw history, exportable anytime
• A built-in orthostatic check for sitting-to-standing blood pressure drops

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• BP Log is available in 46 languages, including Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Hindi, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese and Korean

YOUR DATA, YOUR CALL
• Delete All Data in Settings removes everything, with the option to remove BP Log's readings from Apple Health too

Logging readings, your dashboard, the doctor visit report, orthostatic checks, the Apple Watch app, and full history export are included for everyone, always. BP Log Lifetime (one payment, no subscription, ever) unlocks your full chart history, doctor reports covering up to 12 months, and orthostatic trends over time.

BP Log is an educational tool and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always follow your own physician's guidance.
